title: Figures 97-98: cylinder UAP Mach number at 300 mph and pressure at 400 mph CFD
description: Two CFD contour plots of the cylinder UAP at 1/6 scale and 223K with subsonic inlet and outlet. Figure 97 shows Mach number at 300 mph; Figure 98 shows the pressure field (Pa) at 400 mph with leading-edge stagnation and low-pressure wake pocket. From the BAASS cylinder speed-sweep simulations.
